semiconductor_relevance: High — SPEA S.p.A specializes in automatic test equipment for semiconductor ICs and MEMS, which are critical for ensuring product quality and reliability in the semiconductor industry.
summary: SPEA S.p.A designs and manufactures advanced automatic test equipment for semiconductor ICs, MEMS, and electronic boards. Their systems are utilized across various industries to ensure the quality and reliability of electronic products, making them a key player in the semiconductor testing segment.
